title: Ilford Emergency Help Points
summary: Emergency medical locations, urgent treatment centres, and hazard guidance for Ilford, Seven Kings, and Goodmayes.
content: For immediate life-threatening emergencies, always dial 999 or 112 first. 1. Nearest 24-Hour A&E Hospitals: King George Hospital, Barley Lane, Goodmayes, Ilford IG3 8YB (from Goodmayes station: ~15 min walk east along High Road and north on Barley Lane, or bus 86 or 362). Queen's Hospital, Rom Valley Way, Romford RM7 0AG (from Ilford station: Elizabeth line to Romford, then ~15 min walk south along South Street, or bus 5, 128, or 193). For designated Major Trauma care, the regional centre is The Royal London Hospital, Whitechapel Road, London E1 1FR (from Ilford station: Elizabeth line direct west to Whitechapel). 2. Urgent Treatment Centres: King George Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Barley Lane, Goodmayes, Ilford IG3 8YB (co-located at King George Hospital). Barking Community Hospital Urgent Treatment Centre, Upney Lane, Barking IG11 9LX (from Ilford station: ~25 min walk south down Ilford Lane and Longbridge Road, or bus 169). 3. Area Hazards: The River Roding flows north-to-south along Ilford's western edge; localized flood risk affects the Roding valley, Ilford Golf Course, and low-lying land near the A406 North Circular. Surface water pooling occurs along major underpasses during intense downpours. 4. Supplies: Pharmacies and large supermarkets along Ilford High Road, Cranbrook Road, and High Road Goodmayes can provide water, basic first-aid supplies, and over-the-counter medicines during power outages. Note: addresses and opening hours may have changed — confirm on arrival where possible.
